svg.text: Collection · Inspect → upgrade → build an 8-card deck
Module 04 · Sheet 2/3 · 14 states in this module · 390 × 844 mobile frames
Upgrade requires Gold and copies; Gems never silently substitute. Deck selection validates eight unique cards. Power and reward gates are configurable.
Numbered controls match the route rail beside each phone. Arrows lead to destination screen IDs. Dashed paths are system outcomes, not player buttons.
